A deployable Vickrey variant of RFP-08 on Starknet. Bidder identities stay unlinkable, bid values stay hidden until reveal, every bidder locks identical STRK20-funded collateral, and failing
summary: Conduct sealed-bid, second-price auctions with hidden identities and bid amounts.
description_long: Sealed is a Vickrey variant for conducting sealed-bid auctions where bidders remain anonymous and bid amounts are hidden until reveal.
